scope: Working tree, scripted provider, real Jeeves task execution, workspace files and SQLite receipts. Recovery smoke uses separate processes and controlled external effects.

cases.input: 请把复盘写进 review.md，报告必须包含「12 次事件」。
cases.before: The checked handoff was rejected and no task was created.

after.followUp: The conversational follow-up reused the task. Its new run was recorded as produced_unverified. The first run kept its original verification receipt.

cases.before: The recovered request omitted the original anonymization constraint.
cases.after: The recovered request contained ORCHID-47. The /count value in metrics.json equalled 12 and review.md contained the required text.
Main chat could not reopen a completed checked task created through the explicit task API. Its contract and one run were preserved.
